provenance.giver: lang/ru — patronymic formation from the father's given name: masculine -ович/-евич/-ич, feminine -овна/-евна/-ична/-инична; transliterated forms as they appear in English translations (Maude, Garnett)
provenance.note: A patronymic is worn by every child of one father and individuates nobody by itself (the T5 lesson: Katerina Ivanovna / Alyona Ivanovna are two heads). It is never the head of a name. The transliterated list deliberately omits the bare suffix -ich: it collides with English family names (Aldrich, Goodrich, Ehrlich) at any length floor, so a masculine patronymic formed on a consonant stem (Kuzmich, Fomich) is read as an ordinary name part rather than a patronymic — a disclosed loss on the side of never mistyping a family name; -yich (Ilyich) is kept. minLength is the token floor for the remaining suffixes, this prior's own declared parameter.
